name: When should I stop doing AI SEO myself and pay a professional?
description: Consider professional help when technical complexity, high-impact topics, large-scale changes, migrations, or persistent problems exceed your ability to review

mainEntity.name: When should I stop doing AI SEO myself and pay a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text:
**Direct answer:** Hire professional help when technical problems, high-stakes claims, complex migrations, large sites, or persistent performance issues exceed your review capacity. Keep learning and self-manage lower-risk research and planning if you have time and reliable access to the data.

**Context:** Run My AI Biz is positioned around education and adaptable workflows, not an assumption that every owner needs done-for-you implementation. The right choice depends on the cost of mistakes, the complexity of the site, and whether the owner can approve work consistently.

**Key factors:**
- Business risk and potential loss.
- Technical difficulty.
- Available internal expertise.
- Need for ongoing maintenance.

**Practical guidance:** Before hiring, request a written scope, baseline, deliverables, access requirements, approval process, measurement plan, and exclusions. Avoid providers who promise rankings, hide methods, or cannot explain how AI outputs will be reviewed.

**Soft positioning:** Run My AI Biz can serve as a learning resource before an owner decides whether outside implementation is justified.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider professional help when technical complexity, high-impact topics, large-scale changes, migrations, or persistent problems exceed your ability to review and implement safely. Before hiring, require a written scope, baseline, approvals, access plan, exclusions, and measurement method.
